requirements.title: Validate model output
requirements.gap: Architecture changed (2026-11-12, V8): free-text and LLM-proposed numbers are UNVERIFIED candidates (class A) and never enter automated numeric priority; only a signed simulation-fixture observation (class F, labelled SIMULATED) or an observation approved through the human-verification workflow (class D; authorised reviewer, separation of duties, stale/duplicate-safe, audited) is eligible; authenticated submissions (class C) wait for a human; class E (authenticated sensor) is NOT implemented. Every priority decision is audited. The frozen safety-v8 confirmation (recorded as FAILED and kept unchanged) met every safety gate except complete priority-decision provenance (63/64, SAF8-A-040: a human-verified free-text candidate had no provenance object). A targeted closure (2026-11-12) now gives every numeric candidate a server-built provenance envelope (tenant, incident, observation id, source type, source document, span/offsets or an explicit unavailable-with-reason, origin, trust class, original status; it documents origin and never establishes truth), preserves it unchanged at approval with a separate verification block and audit-event link, and rejects client or LLM supplied provenance; verified by targeted and full regression tests only. The pinned candidate subsequently passed 150 deterministic tests and 18 criteria. The frozen failure remains historical evidence. Verified for the pinned local Gate C candidate. Gautham accepted the current deterministic evidence for Gate C technical purposes with the frozen shortfall retained. This acceptance does not establish production readiness or independent-human review. Behaviour change: numeric priority from a number in a free-text report is no longer automatic; no original V4.1 requirement mandates it, so no formal deviation is proposed. Batch 5 (2026-11-13) added frontend support only (structured observation entry while analysing a report; human verify or reject in the Incident Explorer; server-returned priority displayed), covered by Vitest and a live-stack Playwright test; no backend, policy or frozen-evidence change and no status change. Same-author evidence; see docs/evaluation/numeric-safety-architecture-v8.md and docs/evaluation/numeric-safety-provenance-closure-v8.md
